name: Control
strategy: Restrict enemy actions, interfere with movement, and suppress tactical advantages.

commands.name: Lockdown
commands.effect: When an enemy within Medium of a friendly Unit declares a Charge, reduce its final Charge distance by 1", minimum 0". Charge Impact is unchanged.

commands.name: Interdiction
commands.effect: When an enemy begins a normal Move within Short of a friendly Unit, reduce its Move distance by 2", minimum 1".

commands.name: Disrupt Orders
commands.effect: When an enemy within Medium of friendly Headquarters receives an Attack bonus, remove Accurate 1 from that Attack. If it has no Accurate bonus, reduce its bonus Attacks by one die instead.

commands.name: Suppressing Fire
commands.effect: If one friendly Unit inflicts unsaved Damage with its next ranged Attack this Phase, the target suffers Slow 2 and cannot receive positive Move bonuses from Commands during its next normal Move.

commands.name: Jamming Field
commands.effect: Choose one enemy within Short of a friendly Unit. That enemy cannot use Reactions against the next Attack it suffers this Phase.

doctrineIdentity: Reducing the opponent's tactical options. Control focuses on denying movement and effective responses rather than dealing additional damage.
